title: GSE circular exit-geometry peak-field Teacher export
purpose: Export the qualified 180-bin circular peak targets once for the exact C01-C08 development population without duplicating LiDAR or storing identity.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-2 Teacher generation over exactly 60 C01-C06 fit and 20 C07-C08 selection worlds; zero LiDAR duplication, training, inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed 80-world C01-C08 deduplicated dataset and shard manifest.
Sealed PASS circular exit-geometry field V1R feasibility and exact representation code.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and derived Teacher evidence.

worlds.fit: Exact Cartesian set S01-S10 x C01-C06: 60 worlds, enumerated by the frozen shard manifest.
worlds.selection: Exact Cartesian set S01-S10 x C07-C08: 20 worlds, enumerated by the frozen shard manifest.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Export every source observation once into its own world shard. No resampling, deletion, augmentation, thresholding or test read.

teacher.source: Qualified circular peak encoding of the sealed observable exit mask, robot-frame heading, opening width/mask and four-value vertical profile.
teacher.use: Write 180-bin presence, signed sub-bin residual, width/mask and vertical profile plus sequence/local/global five-frame references. No LiDAR, identity, pose, world feature or future value is stored as a student target.
teacher.valid_mask: Presence is valid at every bin. Width regression uses an independent peak-only mask; all 7887 invalid-width peaks remain present and retain vertical profile.
teacher.student_input: No training or inference in this operation. Future datasets join this Teacher to sealed LiDAR only through global sequence/frame references.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created; executed traversal remains the only future edge authority.

split.strict_test: C09/C10/M-TARE unread and absent from all output paths.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only the frozen C01-C08 dataset and V1R feasibility evidence are read.

methods.main: One Zarr shard per world with sparse-compressible dense 180-bin target arrays and exact causal provenance.
methods.baseline: No new baseline is run; the bound V1R includes wide-sector and raw-range comparisons.
methods.fallback: Any source/hash/join/count/round-trip/mask/size or forbidden-array failure stops export and training.

acceptance.population: 80 shards, 188126 rows, fit/selection 142184/45942, 396913 peaks and 389026/7887 width split.
acceptance.content: Exact arrays are presence/residual/width/width-mask/profile/count plus sequence and frame references; no range, valid scan, pose or identity arrays.
acceptance.integrity: Every shard is reopened and compared elementwise; heading round-trip <=1e-4 degree; total compressed size <1 GiB; manifest/tree hashes complete.

failure_policy: Fail closed on any drift or partial shard; do not overwrite, retry selectively, drop invalid widths or change dtype/compression after execution.
retention: Retain all 80 Teacher shards, manifest, summary, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal; these are the sole training targets for the peak-field route.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only encode, compressed Zarr write and full readback
